about: Verdict vectors: for each case, the acts a verifier holds (by id, from the pool: each act's complete bytes, outside, locked inside and signature, as Envelopes encodes an act; every act public, its content key on its outside), the facts it holds beside them that are not acts (inclusion proofs a home served, homes it failed to reach, anchors it checked, rail answers it was given), the question asked and the verdict the texts give, with the rule that decides it. Questions: status (Identity's standing of an act: valid, pending, void, disputed, invalid, unknown, scoped); chain (the acts counting at each position of an identity chain, what stops it, and homes proven dishonest from a position on); status after keepers (Identity's standing once Agreements has read the keeper records held and named the acts their keepers recorded before the rotation voiding them); backing (Agreements rule 80 for an act of a grant key); consent counts (whether an act of a collective has the consent its areas need); agreement exists; deal fork; deadline (rule 33, under the keepers and rule given, on the clock given, at the point given); paid toward (what counts toward an obligation); disagreements (how many open questions a receiver shows, Money rule 11). The MIR hashes are stand-ins, SHA-256 of a label, until the freeze: identity, envelopes, text, money, agreements, development below. Every key is test data derived from a name.

agreements.name: a deal one party has not signed: does not exist
agreements.why: A deal exists once every party has signed it.

agreements.name: a deal every party signed: exists
agreements.why: Terms plus every party's signature act.

agreements.name: two complete versions of one version: a fork, the version before it the reference
agreements.why: Every party signed both; neither is in force; the reference stays.

agreements.name: a collective's act its area needs two holders for, signed by one: does not count
agreements.why: The area reaching Money has two holders and threshold 2.

agreements.name: the same signed by both holders: counts
agreements.why: Both holders' signature acts name it.

agreements.name: an act of a grant key within its reach, the grant accepted: backed
an act the revocation's history holds: binds
agreements.why: It is in the revocation's history (the revocation cites it).

agreements.name: an act the revocation misses, nobody else acknowledging it: void
agreements.why: Racing the revocation, relied on by nobody.

agreements.name: an act the revocation misses, another identity acknowledging it: disputed
agreements.why: A fan acknowledged it by a witness act: valid, shown disputed, conferring nothing unless the grantor adopts it.

agreements.name: an act the revocation misses, only its grantee acknowledging it: void
agreements.why: The grantee's own acknowledgement does not count.

agreements.name: an act the revocation misses, recorded by a keeper of a deal it belongs to before the revocation: disputed
agreements.why: It names the deal in objects; the deal's keeper recorded it, then the revocation.

agreements.name: a deal's keeper recorded the act before the rotation: disputed
agreements.why: Only a record before the keeper's own record of the rotation, in its sequence, counts against it.

agreements.name: the deal's keeper recorded the act only after the rotation: void
agreements.why: Only a record before the keeper's own record of the rotation, in its sequence, counts against it.

agreements.name: a deadline met by an anchor of the act
agreements.verdict: met, by an anchor of the act
agreements.why: An anchor of the act at or before the point shows it made in time.

agreements.name: a deadline met by both keepers' records lying before their records anchored by the point
agreements.verdict: met, by the keepers' anchored records
agreements.why: Each keeper's record of the act lies before a record of its anchored at or before the point; the rule is all.

agreements.name: a deadline missed: both keepers' sequences anchored past the point hold no record of the act
agreements.why: Their records anchored at 150 have no record of the act before them.

agreements.name: a deadline with no anchor: undetermined
agreements.why: A keeper's sequence orders; only anchors place anything on the clock.

agreements.name: an anchor of the act wins over the keepers' silence
agreements.verdict: met, by an anchor of the act
agreements.why: The act is anchored at the point; the keepers' anchored sequences lack it.

development.name: a payment cMIP: field 2 lists Money's task 6
development.why: Kind 0, a creator, field 2 naming [MONEY, 6], its text.

development.name: a rail Module under a payment cMIP, with fields 11 and 13
development.rule: Development, "A rail Module's kind and binding"
development.why: A request rail binding payee and purpose.

development.name: a rail Module under a payment cMIP without fields 11 and 13: no specification
development.rule: Development, "A rail Module's kind and binding"
development.why: Its field 5 names a cMIP whose field 2 lists Money's task 6.

development.name: the same at a verifier not holding the cMIP it names: unknown
development.rule: Development, "A rail Module's kind and binding"
development.verdict: unknown: the cMIP 54ff9b06303e3e38b70cbab34ba64218c3c41c6259d4ed3d5b13bc3620ed9602 is not held
development.why: Whether it is a specification rests on the cMIP's own field 2.

development.name: a request rail whose field 13 lacks the purpose: no specification
development.rule: Development, "A rail Module's kind and binding"

development.name: a cMIP naming no creator: no specification
a key the format does not define (14): no specification

envelopes.name: a sequence of two acts, prev, position and summary fitting: valid
envelopes.why: Act 2 names act 1 in prev, at position 2, carrying the summary over act 1.

envelopes.name: an act under a specification the verifier does not implement: unknown
envelopes.why: Its shape and signature check, and its signer's chain binds the key: Identity's standing is valid; its type is a cMIP's this verifier does not implement.

envelopes.name: the same with a broken signature: invalid, which beats unknown
envelopes.why: Every rule the verifier can apply is applied first.

envelopes.name: an everyday act with no prev: invalid
envelopes.why: Every everyday act carries key 2, with at most one entry.

envelopes.name: an everyday act with two prev entries: invalid
envelopes.why: At most one entry: a sequence never branches inside one act.

identity.name: a genesis, valid
identity.why: Signed by the signing key it declares, with a home.

identity.name: a genesis signed by a key it does not declare
identity.why: A genesis MUST be signed by the signing key it declares.

identity.name: a rotation counting on its home's receipt
identity.rule: Identity, "Which rotation counts"; receipt checks 1 to 6
identity.why: The home the rule names receipted it.

identity.name: a rotation not yet receipted: pending
identity.why: No receipt of its home yet.

identity.name: an act bound to a pending rotation: pending
identity.why: Its binding is a rotation that does not count yet.

identity.name: two genuine rotations receipted by one home: contested
identity.why: Neither receipt counts; the identity is contested at position 1, not frozen.

identity.name: an act a rotation disowns: void
a disowned act another identity acknowledged: disputed
identity.why: Another identity acknowledged it by a witness act (Identity type 15).

identity.name: a disowned act its deal's keeper recorded before the rotation: disputed
identity.rule: Identity rule 34; Agreements rules 41 and 42, "Belongs to", "Keeper record (type 2)"
identity.why: The act names the deal in objects, so belongs to it; the keeper the deal names recorded it before recording the rotation. The keeper records are type 2 acts the verifier reads; Agreements tells Identity which acts its keepers rescue.

identity.name: the same recorded by a keeper the deal does not name: void
identity.why: A record counts only from a keeper named by an agreement the act belongs to.

identity.name: an escape: a homeless rotation endorsed by the signing key
identity.why: Both keys, its new home's receipt; no old home's receipt is needed.

identity.name: a rotation declaring a successor: it counts, the succession declared
identity.why: The rotation counts; the successor is shown as declared until it confirms.

identity.name: a receipt from an operator that is no home of the identity changes nothing
identity.why: Only the homes the rule names count.

identity.name: a home receipting two genuine rotations at one position, both under cosigned summaries: proven dishonest there
identity.why: The identity requires audit; both receipts sit under cosigned log summaries, and a cosigned receipt survives the home's rotation. Position 2 counts on homes 2 and 3; home 1 counts for nothing for this identity after position 2.

# MIR: Test

## Part one

A rule.

money.name: a receipt and a claim of one payment agreeing: no question on the receiver
money.why: The rail's answer is stated as a fact (the core reads no rail): both valid, paid to the payee's flow. Where they disagree in amount, the greater counts and the question is shown on the receiver.

money.name: a receipt for less than the claim: a question on the receiver
money.why: The rail's answer is stated as a fact (the core reads no rail): both valid, paid to the payee's flow. Where they disagree in amount, the greater counts and the question is shown on the receiver.

money.name: a payee's receipt signed with its grant key: backed
money.why: A person's grant whose kinds reach receipts; the grantee accepted it.

money.name: a collective's receipt signed with the member key of its Money area's holder: counts
money.why: Ben holds the area reaching Money, at one signature.

money.name: the same signed with the member key of a member holding no Money area: does not count
money.why: Cy's key reaches no area that reaches Money.

money.name: a transfer to one's vault naming the vault's declaration: valid, and it pays no obligation
money.why: Field 5 names the identity's genesis, which declares its vault: an act Money reads for another purpose, so the payment fulfils nothing in Money's sense; the debtor's obligation of the same amount stays unpaid.

text.name: a text act, canonical
text.python: text act format and rule 14 at a Text-only verifier
text.why: Field 0 canonical text, no other field.

text.name: a text act whose text is not in NFC: invalid
text.python: text act format and rule 14 at a Text-only verifier
text.why: Every text field is canonical; e followed by a combining acute is not NFC.

text.name: a text act carrying two objects: invalid
text.python: text act format and rule 14 at a Text-only verifier
text.why: Any objects outside rule 14's two cases, two objects included, is invalid at every verifier.

text.name: a text act naming another identity's chain: invalid
text.python: text act format and rule 14 at a Text-only verifier
text.why: Its one object must name its own signer as chain.

text.name: an individual's text naming its own chain: invalid where Agreements is read
text.why: Its signer is no collective and its key no grant key: neither case. A Text-only verifier answers unknown instead (it cannot tell a collective).

text.name: a collective's text naming its own latest decision: valid
text.rule: Text rule 14, first case; Agreements rule 58
text.why: Exactly one object, [collective, decision]: its genesis, a link of its own chain.

text.name: a member key's text naming the version that named the key: scoped, and it counts
text.why: The one object is [collective, the founding its binding's signature names]; Ana's area reaches texts.

text.name: a member key's text naming the signature act itself: invalid
text.why: For a member key the object names the version, never the signature act.
